seo.title: Start a Project | VISH Studio
seo.description: Tell VISH Studio about your social media marketing, SaaS, website, software, mobile app, branding, or AI automation project.

steps.label: Service
steps.title: Choose a service
steps.intro: Answer a few focused questions so we can understand your goals and recommend the right scope.

steps.label: Package
steps.title: Choose a package
steps.intro: Pick the starting scope that feels closest to your project. We can refine the final scope after reviewing your brief.

steps.label: Project brief
steps.title: Tell us about the project
steps.intro: Share the context, goals, features, and constraints that will help us understand what needs to be built.

steps.label: Contact
steps.title: How can we reach you
steps.intro: Add your contact details so the studio can follow up after reviewing the project brief.

steps.label: Review
steps.title: Review your brief
steps.intro: Check the service, package, project answers, and contact details before submitting your brief.

labels.privacyText: Your details are used only to review this brief and contact you about the project.
labels.errorMessage: Unable to submit your brief. Please try again.

confirmation.label: Brief submitted
confirmation.heading: Your project brief has been submitted
confirmation.description: We’ll review the questionnaire and contact you with the next steps. Your reference is {reference}.
confirmation.contactPrompt: Need to add more information or make a request? Contact us directly:
